# tm-grammars licence files

`NOTICE` and `LICENSE` are copied unchanged from the npm package
[tm-grammars](https://www.npmjs.com/package/tm-grammars) 1.32.22
(`https://registry.npmjs.org/tm-grammars/-/tm-grammars-1.32.22.tgz`,
integrity `sha512-VKWL+UiqlGqbGHonRbrBc0kkqDIHUUiVO/A2rBTBz5LBXKA8Fe2f34O1YiBI7ED37tTUlT3MGmLf9+0F/H4/Ww==`),
the package the code-highlighting grammars of `@shikijs/langs` are built from.
`NOTICE` lists every grammar with its source, its licence and the licence text;
`LICENSE` is the licence of tm-grammars itself (MIT).

No code from tm-grammars is kept here: the grammars reach the app through
`@shikijs/langs`. The files are here so that `cargo xtask notices` can put
them in `THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt`. Replace both when `@shikijs/langs` moves to
a newer tm-grammars.
